title: Fwd Cargo Door Latching Web — Hook Seat Fretting Repair

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Permanent repair for fretting damage at the hook seats of the forward cargo door latching web, using a bonded and bolted seat insert that restores the seat geometry without replacing the web.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the hook seat geometry of the forward cargo door latching web after fretting, so that the web does not have to be replaced for local damage at one or two stations.
sections.damage_assessment: Measure the seat depth at each of the eight hook stations with the seat gauge and compare against the nominal. Fretting up to 0.6 mm of depth loss at no more than two stations, with no cracking visible under ten times magnification, is inside this repair. Depth loss above 0.6 mm, damage at three or more stations, or any crack at the seat radius is outside it and the web must be replaced. On aircraft with the load-sharing carriage, measure the rail seat as well and record the carriage travel before and after, because a fretted rail seat changes the take-up and the travel reading is the more sensitive indicator.
sections.repair_procedure: Clean the seat and do a dye penetrant inspection to confirm there is no crack. Machine the seat square to the depth given on repair drawing RD-52-30-13-001, removing the minimum material that gives a clean face. Do a second dye penetrant inspection of the machined face. Cut the seat insert to the drawing and check the fit dry; the insert must sit proud by the interference value on the drawing before it is bonded. Prepare both faces to the bonding standard and install the insert wet with structural adhesive, clamped for the cure time given. Drill the retention pattern through the insert into the web with the drill jig and do an eddy current inspection of each hole. Fasten the insert with blind rivets AGS534950-40 and shear head bolts AGS773887-1B on the pattern shown. Where the inboard shear tie GRA7840-60 seats over the repaired station, check its seating with witness paste after the insert is installed. Re-check the seat depth and, on carriage aircraft, re-measure the carriage travel.
sections.inspection_requirements: The repair is life limited to 12 000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment. Do a repeat seat depth measurement and a visual check of the insert edge at each C-check. On carriage aircraft, include the repaired station in the carriage travel check and treat any reading outside the tolerance band as invalidating the repair. A second repair at the same station is not permitted; the web must be replaced. Report the repair to Aeralis with the seat depth record.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Fretting up to 0.6 mm depth loss at no more than two hook stations, with no crack visible under ten times magnification at the seat radius.

repair_drawings.title: Hook seat insert, fwd cargo door latching web

type_data.fastener_pattern: Twelve blind rivets AGS534950-40 around the insert perimeter at 15 mm pitch, with four shear head bolts AGS773887-1B on the load-bearing edge, per station
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Repair is life limited to 12 000 flight cycles; seat depth re-measured at each C-check. A second repair at the same station is not permitted.
